Profit and Loss Statement Group — Edit

This form creates or edits groups for the profit and loss statement.

Groups organize income and expense accounts for financial reporting.

Name

The name of the group as it will appear in reports. Choose a descriptive name that clearly identifies the category (e.g., 'Sales Revenue', 'Operating Expenses', 'Cost of Goods Sold').

Type

Select whether this is a top-level group or a subgroup of another group. Subgroups help create more detailed categorization within main groups.

Group

Select the parent group that this subgroup belongs to. This creates a hierarchical structure in your reports.

Position

The display order of this group in reports. Lower numbers appear first. Use this to customize the sequence of groups (e.g., show revenue groups before expense groups).
